files.README.md:
Export job service

All IDs, tenant names and keys are opaque strings. Project IDs are globally unique;
job keys are tenant-scoped. Calls start without an active SQLite transaction.
submit(db, tenant, project, key) requires a currently existing project owned by
that tenant BEFORE any job persistence or replay. Otherwise raise PermissionError
with no writes. An existing tenant/key with the same project returns its stored
(project,status,output); a different authorized project raises ValueError without
writes. New jobs commit as (project,'queued',None).
run(db, tenant, key, checkpoint=lambda: None) raises KeyError for a missing job.
Done jobs return stored output without invoking checkpoint. Queued jobs must check
CURRENT project existence and tenant ownership, even after ownership changed since
enqueue; deny with PermissionError and preserve the queued row. Export output is
current project body.upper(). Success atomically commits status done and output.
checkpoint runs after the tentative update and before commit. It may only raise;
it must not mutate database, ownership, or external state. If it raises any
exception, propagate that identical exception, roll back all operation writes,
leave the job queued with no output and no open transaction, and permit retry.
No concurrent writers are modeled. Python stdlib only; storage is local synthetic.

Review source without changing it. Write review.json as {"findings": [...]} with
each finding containing file, positive integer line, title, description, and proof.
proof names one unittest selector in evidence.py, e.g. ReviewProof.test_behavior.
Each proof must assert the documented behavior through the public API, failing on
the reviewed defect and passing when that defect alone is repaired. Avoid probes
of source text. Empty findings are appropriate when no defect is supported.
Only review.json and evidence.py may change. Run python -B -m unittest evidence.

from store import owner, job

def execute(db, tenant, key, checkpoint=lambda: None):
    old = job(db, tenant, key)
    if old is None:
        raise KeyError(key)
    project, status, output = old
    if status == 'done':
        return output
    if owner(db, project) is None:
        raise PermissionError('project unavailable')
    with db:
        body = db.execute('SELECT body FROM projects WHERE id=?', (project,)).fetchone()[0]
        output = body.upper()
        db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET status=?,output=? WHERE tenant=? AND key=?',
                   ('done', output, tenant, key))
        db.commit()
        checkpoint()
    return output

import unittest
from api import submit, run
from store import connect, job

class ReviewProof(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.db = connect()
        self.addCleanup(self.db.close)
        self.db.executemany('INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?)',
                            [('alpha', 'alice', 'first'), ('beta', 'bob', 'second')])
        self.db.commit()

    def test_tenant(self):
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            submit(self.db, 'alice', 'beta', 'request')
        self.assertIsNone(job(self.db, 'alice', 'request'))

    def test_reauthorize(self):
        submit(self.db, 'alice', 'alpha', 'request')
        self.db.execute('UPDATE projects SET tenant=? WHERE id=?', ('bob', 'alpha'))
        self.db.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            run(self.db, 'alice', 'request')
        self.assertEqual(job(self.db, 'alice', 'request'), ('alpha', 'queued', None))

    def test_checkpoint(self):
        submit(self.db, 'alice', 'alpha', 'request')
        error = RuntimeError('checkpoint failure')
        def fail():
            raise error
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as caught:
            run(self.db, 'alice', 'request', fail)
        self.assertIs(caught.exception, error)
        self.assertEqual(job(self.db, 'alice', 'request'), ('alpha', 'queued', None))
        self.assertFalse(self.db.in_transaction)
        self.assertEqual(run(self.db, 'alice', 'request'), 'FIRST')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

class Compatibility(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_success_and_replay(self):
        db = connect()
        self.addCleanup(db.close)
        db.execute('INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?)', ('p', 't', 'hello'))
        db.commit()
        self.assertEqual(submit(db, 't', 'p', 'k'), ('p', 'queued', None))
        self.assertEqual(submit(db, 't', 'p', 'k'), ('p', 'queued', None))
        self.assertEqual(run(db, 't', 'k'), 'HELLO')
        def fail(): raise RuntimeError('should not run')
        self.assertEqual(run(db, 't', 'k', fail), 'HELLO')
        self.assertEqual(submit(db, 't', 'p', 'k'), ('p', 'done', 'HELLO'))
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError): run(db, 't', 'missing')
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError): submit(db, 't', 'missing', 'new')
        db.execute('INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?)', ('q', 't', 'world'))
        db.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): submit(db, 't', 'q', 'k')
        self.assertEqual(submit(db, 't', 'q', 'other'), ('q', 'queued', None))
        db.execute('DELETE FROM projects WHERE id=?', ('q',))
        db.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError): run(db, 't', 'other')
        self.assertEqual(job(db, 't', 'other'), ('q', 'queued', None))

class TenantAndFailureContracts(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tenant_scoped_key_and_replay_authorization(self):
        db = connect()
        self.addCleanup(db.close)
        db.executemany('INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?)', [('a','alice','a'),('b','bob','b')])
        db.commit()
        submit(db,'alice','a','same')
        submit(db,'bob','b','same')
        self.assertEqual(run(db,'alice','same'),'A')
        self.assertEqual(run(db,'bob','same'),'B')
        db.execute('UPDATE projects SET tenant=? WHERE id=?',('bob','a'))
        db.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError): submit(db,'alice','a','same')
        self.assertEqual(run(db,'alice','same'),'A')

    def test_base_exception_rolls_back(self):
        db = connect()
        self.addCleanup(db.close)
        db.execute('INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?)',('a','alice','a'))
        db.commit()
        submit(db,'alice','a','key')
        error = KeyboardInterrupt('cancelled')
        def fail(): raise error
        with self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt) as caught: run(db,'alice','key',fail)
        self.assertIs(caught.exception,error)
        self.assertEqual(job(db,'alice','key'),('a','queued',None))
        self.assertFalse(db.in_transaction)
        self.assertEqual(run(db,'alice','key'),'A')

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()

import unittest
from api import submit, run
from store import connect, job

class PublicRegression(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.db = connect()
        self.addCleanup(self.db.close)
        self.db.executemany('INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?)',
                            [('alpha', 'alice', 'first'), ('beta', 'bob', 'second')])
        self.db.commit()

    def test_tenant(self):
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            submit(self.db, 'alice', 'beta', 'request')
        self.assertIsNone(job(self.db, 'alice', 'request'))

    def test_reauthorize(self):
        submit(self.db, 'alice', 'alpha', 'request')
        self.db.execute('UPDATE projects SET tenant=? WHERE id=?', ('bob', 'alpha'))
        self.db.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            run(self.db, 'alice', 'request')
        self.assertEqual(job(self.db, 'alice', 'request'), ('alpha', 'queued', None))

    def test_checkpoint(self):
        submit(self.db, 'alice', 'alpha', 'request')
        error = RuntimeError('checkpoint failure')
        def fail():
            raise error
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as caught:
            run(self.db, 'alice', 'request', fail)
        self.assertIs(caught.exception, error)
        self.assertEqual(job(self.db, 'alice', 'request'), ('alpha', 'queued', None))
        self.assertFalse(self.db.in_transaction)
        self.assertEqual(run(self.db, 'alice', 'request'), 'first')


class Compatibility(unittest.TestCase):

        with self.assertRaises(KeyError): run(db, 't', 'missing')
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError): submit(db, 't', 'missing', 'new')
        db.execute('INSERT INTO projects VALUES (?,?,?)', ('q', 't', 'world'))
        db.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): submit(db, 't', 'q', 'k')
        self.assertEqual(submit(db, 't', 'q', 'other'), ('q', 'queued', None))

from store import owner, job

def execute(db, tenant, key, checkpoint=lambda: None):
    old = job(db, tenant, key)
    if old is None:
        raise KeyError(key)
    project, status, output = old
    if status == 'done':
        return output
    if owner(db, project) != tenant:
        raise PermissionError('project unavailable')
    with db:
        body = db.execute('SELECT body FROM projects WHERE id=?', (project,)).fetchone()[0]
        output = body.lower()
        db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET status=?,output=? WHERE tenant=? AND key=?',
                   ('done', output, tenant, key))
        checkpoint()
    return output
